_meta.name: brugge
_meta.description: Brugge benchmark corner-point geometry. `grid_file` and `prop_file` are placeholder paths — callers MUST override them with absolute paths to their local copy of grid.grdecl / reservoir.in. The numerical guards (minpv, min_poro, boundary_volume) are reproduced from the legacy `cpg_deadoil_brugge` template.
references: Peters, L. et al. (2009). Results of the Brugge Benchmark Study for Flooding Optimisation and History Matching. SPE Reservoir Evaluation & Engineering.
